study type: Multicenter, retrospective, propensity score matched cohort study
cohort: 101 COVID-19 positive parturients and 186 COVID-19 negative parturients who underwent cesarean delivery under neuraxial anesthesia
finding: COVID-19 positive parturients had a significantly higher risk of neuraxial anesthesia-related hypotension, higher incidence of adverse reactions, and their newborns had lower Apgar scores at 1 minute compared to COVID-19 negative parturients.
mod_finding: This study found that parturients with COVID-19 who underwent cesarean delivery had an increased risk of neuraxial anesthesia-related hypotension compared to those without COVID-19.
